name: Guttesen's kagome glider in Life
description: H. S. Guttesen's small glider g (arXiv:2608.27622, Fig. 4) on the trihexagonal (kagome) tiling 3.6.3.6 in Conway's Life, B3/S23: 4 or 5 cells, period 4, one lattice step every 4 generations. JETCARP's soup searches found it independently; the object is Guttesen's.
